name: Codebase changes
author: Brett
description: Every time Claude is asked to build, edit, remove or fix something, an entry is opened (by a Claude Code hook) with what was asked, broken into steps that Claude fills in as it works, and the result when it's done (branch, commits, files, tests, links). A Codebase changes banner on every console load lists the entries you haven't closed; closing one clears it on every device. The permanent log lives on axHub (/projects/amberx-axf/_data/changes) and is browsable under Builds → Codebase changes.

keeps: changes/ in the shared data folder (/projects/amberx-axf/_data/changes on axHub, and the repo's changes/ snapshot): Brett's permanent record, never deleted by uninstall
